content.text:
I changed `runDaemonForContext` in `packages/playwright/src/mcp/test/browserBackend.ts` so `--debug=cli` no longer fails when a test creates a second `BrowserContext`. The root `tsc --noEmit` passes, but I have not run the reproduction or any tests.

**Cause:** `runDaemonForContext` runs for every context created during a test and calls `browser.bind()` each time. A browser can only be bound once, so the second `browser.newContext()` (here, from the worker-scoped fixture) hit `Server is already started`.

**Fix:** The browser is now bound only the first time it is seen. A module-level `WeakMap` stores the session name per browser. Later contexts on the same browser reuse that name in the "run `playwright-cli attach ...`" message and still call `requestPause()` on their own context. Because the map is keyed by browser, this also covers a reused worker that runs several tests on one browser.

**Choice I made:** Each additional context still pauses at its start. If you would rather only the first context pause, that is a one-line change.

I did not commit anything.
